newsitem.title: USA: Bidermann Industries USA Inc sells two units.
newsitem.headline: Bidermann Industries USA Inc sells two units.

text.p: Bidermann Industries USA Inc said on Wednesday that its subsidiaries, Cluett, Peabody & Co Inc and Bidermann Tailored Clothing Inc, have been sold and combined to form a new company.
Details of the buyer were not given.
The new company, which is being called Cluett Designer Group, will not be involved in Bidermann's Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings.
The new company received $15 million in funding from the CIT Group, which will be used to purchase assets and for working capital purposes.

Cluett Designer will market and sell clothing under licensed Yves Saint Laurent and Burberrys brand names. It expects to reach net sales of about $40 million in the first full year of operation, Bidermann said.
The transaction was approved by the judge overseeing Bidermann's bankruptcy proceedings.
Jean Kolloff, previously president of Bidermann Industries' Burberrys and Yves Saint Laurent operations, is president of Cluett Designer Group.
